en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Hasan b. Matil al-Daqqaq narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab narrated to us from Muhammad b. Sinan from al-Mufaddal b. `Umar. He said: I asked Aba `Abdillah (as) about desire (al-`ishq), so he said:
Hearts that are empty of the remembrance of Allah, so Allah gives them the taste of a love that is other than His.
